goal: Make the audit dashboard pages read per-session projections instead of replaying every event on each request, add a timeline scrubber to session details, and let todo bookkeeping run while a harness run is paused.
deliverables: services/harness-audit/src/ (projectors, indexed session queries, scrubber snapshots)
scripts/workflow_gate.py (trusted checkout todo bookkeeping during a pause)
constraints: No new crate or Python dependencies.
The JSON API responses keep their shape.
Pages show the same content as before for the same events; tests compare projection output with a full replay.
Startup still rebuilds every projection from the event store.

non_goals.description: No change to what the collectors record or the event schema.
No live push or polling of running sessions in this task.

acceptance.criterion: The audit service test suite passes
The phase guard tests pass, including todo bookkeeping during a pause
Against the live database, /workflow and the largest session render at least five times faster than the baseline (1.78 s and 0.83 s)
Dragging the scrubber updates the verdict strip, todos and flow highlight without a request per step
